verseText: Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
meaning: Jesus invites tired and burdened people to come to him. He gives true rest, teaches us gently, and cares for our souls.
